inlines.v: FLUE, n. [probably contracted from flume, L. flumen, from fluo.] A passage for smoke in a chimney, leading from the fireplace to the top of the chinmey, or into another passage; as a chinmey with four flues. FLUE, n. [L. pluma.] Soft down or fur; very fine hair. [Local.]
